name: seo-gets
description: Ask questions about connected Google Search Console and GA4 properties, investigate SEO performance, and turn the findings into reports and action plans.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to SEO Gets to explore Google Search Console and GA4 data across one or more properties. Ask about performance trends, pages, queries, date ranges, indexing status, and errors. SEO Gets can also use your content groups, topic clusters, and brand keyword filters to create reports and practical action plans.
defaultPrompt: Compare organic search performance across my connected properties for the last 28 days.
Which pages and queries gained or lost the most clicks this month?
Check indexing status and errors for my connected properties.
